scientific.integrity: The conditional regression, covariance, and variance identities are reconstructed analytically. A standalone exact-rational checker independently replays finite algebra, kernel integrals, and correlation formulas. The recorded public date and primary MSC are taken from an identified goodness-of-fit source with explicit online date and classification.
scientific.limitations: Exact for the transformed continuous-uniform null. No raw-scale endpoint statement for arbitrary parent distributions, no composite-null parameter estimation, and no censoring extension is asserted. The endpoint correlation decays at order one over sample size. Older exact-distribution literature remains a residual originality risk because some complete bodies were not lawfully accessible in the checked path.
